name: @komerza/skinloop-rust-cloudflare
description: Standalone Cloudflare Worker bridge for Komerza orders and Skinloop Rust payments

SKINLOOP_API_KEY.description: Skinloop server API key with checkout:create and checkout:read scopes, restricted to Rust.

KOMERZA_API_KEY.description: Komerza server API key for the merchant store. This remains in the merchant's Cloudflare account.

SKINLOOP_API_BASE_URL.description: Exact Skinloop merchant API base URL shown in the Skinloop dashboard.

SKINLOOP_HOSTED_ORIGIN.description: Allowed origin for Skinloop hosted checkout URLs.

KOMERZA_STORE_ID.description: Komerza store UUID that owns the orders handled by this Worker.

SHOP_URL.description: Customer-facing Komerza shop URL used by return and cancel pages.
